findings.title: Success does not establish a login session
findings.trigger: The identity service returns a successful response and the API returns authenticated: true.
findings.impact: The client switches to the dashboard, but the traced implementation sets no session cookie or token. Subsequent requests have no authentication credential from this flow.
findings.suggestion: Verify the provider response, create a server-side session, and set an appropriate HTTP-only session cookie before returning success.

findings.title: Provider outages are reported as invalid credentials
findings.trigger: The identity service responds with HTTP 429 or 5xx instead of throwing.
findings.impact: The server returns 401 Invalid credentials for every non-success response, hiding an upstream outage and misleading the user.
findings.suggestion: Handle explicit credential rejection separately from rate limits and provider failures, preserving a service-unavailable outcome.
